from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations,product
from collections import Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from math import comb
import json
c=json.loads((Path.cwd()/"docs/research/matrix-native-results/b649-min-s2-t257-t237-joint-exact-authority-r1-result.json").read_bytes())
D=(6,)+(5,)*10+(4,3,2,1)
@lru_cache(None)
def hh(ds):
    remaining=sorted(ds)
    while remaining:
        degree=remaining.pop()
        if degree<0 or degree>len(remaining):return False
        if degree==0:return True
        for j in range(1,degree+1):
            remaining[-j]-=1
            if remaining[-j]<0:return False
        remaining.sort()
    return True
# Independently grow zero graphs by attaching a new labelled vertex to
# every possible subset of existing vertices.
graphs=[(0,)]
for n in range(1,5):
    grown=[]
    for deg in graphs:
        for subset in range(1<<n):
            bits=tuple((subset>>v)&1 for v in range(n))
            grown.append(tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(deg,bits))+(sum(bits),))
    graphs=grown
zero=Counter(tuple(sorted(6-x for x in deg)) for deg in graphs)
@lru_cache(None)
def compatible(s):
    h=tuple(8-d+x for d,x in zip(D,s))
    if not hh(tuple(sorted(h))):return ()
    out=[]
    for z in zero:
        if sum(z)!=sum(s):continue
        # Independent conjugate-column majorization checks, opposite
        # to the first reproduction's constructive row greedy.
        dz=sorted(z,reverse=True)
        conjugate=[sum(x>=k for x in s) for k in range(1,6)]
        if all(sum(dz[:k])<=sum(conjugate[:k]) for k in range(1,6)):out.append(z)
    return tuple(out)
actual=Counter();labelled_core=0;raw=0

    for tail in product(range(3),range(4),range(5),range(6)):
        s=(0,)+tuple(sorted(bits))+tail;raw+=1
        zs=compatible(s);labelled_core+=bool(zs)
        for z in zs:actual[(s,z)]+=1

assert dict(actual)==expected

pairs=sum(mult*zero[z] for (s,z),mult in actual.items())
assert pairs==c["ENUMERATION"]["LABELLED_CORE_GRAPH_PAIRS"]
# Complete six-vertex graph check of the general shore partition identity.
edges=tuple(combinations(range(6),2));triples=tuple(combinations(range(6),3))
checks=0;totals=[0,0,0,0]
for mask in range(1<<len(edges)):
    adj=[set() for _ in range(6)]
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(edges):
        if mask>>i&1:adj[a].add(b);adj[b].add(a)
    s=[len(adj[v]&{3,4,5}) for v in range(3)]
    z=[len(adj[v]&{0,1,2}) for v in range(3,6)]
    h=[2-len(adj[v]&{0,1,2}) for v in range(3)]
    mu=[2-len(adj[v]&{3,4,5}) for v in range(3,6)]
    parts=[set() for _ in range(4)];t=0;tc=0
    for triple in triples:
        a,b,d=triple
        t+=b in adj[a] and d in adj[a] and d in adj[b]
        tc+=b not in adj[a] and d not in adj[a] and d not in adj[b]
        core=[v for v in triple if v<3];zero_v=[v for v in triple if v>=3]
        if len(core)==3 and all(y not in adj[x] for x,y in combinations(core,2)):parts[0].add(triple)
        if len(zero_v)==3 and all(y not in adj[x] for x,y in combinations(zero_v,2)):parts[1].add(triple)
        if len(core)==2 and core[1] not in adj[core[0]] and all(zero_v[0] in adj[v] for v in core):parts[2].add(triple)
        if len(zero_v)==2 and zero_v[1] not in adj[zero_v[0]] and all(core[0] in adj[v] for v in zero_v):parts[3].add(triple)
    assert sum(map(len,parts))==len(set().union(*parts))
    p=sum(map(len,parts))
    constant=comb(6,3)-sum(len(ns)*(5-len(ns)) for ns in adj)//2
    mixed_base=3*(sum(h)//2)+3*(sum(mu)//2)-sum(a*b for a,b in zip(s,h))-sum(a*b for a,b in zip(z,mu))
    assert tc==mixed_base+p and t==constant-mixed_base-p and constant==t+tc
    totals=[a+len(b) for a,b in zip(totals,parts)];checks+=1
